about: Polo Queen Industrial and Fintech Ltd is a Mumbai-based trading-led group spanning textiles, branded FMCG, chemicals/minerals and a small non-deposit-taking NBFC. Its Poloqueen /Doan Rajkamal portfolio serves civilian and defence channels, while specialty cleaning additives are produced through third-party job work. It also owns Mahad and Dombivli property assets and proposes agro-processing and data-centre projects.
